base_member_text: CALCULATE_CD_BREAKWATER: east/north ramp offsets use (px-npx-1)*(iiend-iista+1) (L280/L331/L423/L474/L565/L617) which assumes equal block widths across ranks; Din2D @L99, xx @L240/@L379/@L523, DXg/DYg locals (L247-248 etc.), Stokes_Drift_Ser/Grav imports, R_sponge/A_sponge dummies in friction/diffusion versions are declared/imported but unused in their routines
audit_member_text: CALCULATE_FRICTION_SPONGE의 인터페이스는 R_sponge/A_sponge를 L235-L236에서 받고 CALCULATE_DIFFUSION_SPONGE도 L374-L375에서 받지만 두 서브루틴 본문은 이 인수를 한 번도 사용하지 않고 각각 GLOBAL의 CDsponge/Csp만 사용한다(L265-L333, L404-L476). 호출자가 R/A로 형태를 제어한다고 기대하면 인터페이스와 구현이 불일치한다.

ABSORBING_GENERATING_BC의 Din2D는 L99에서 선언되지만 대입·참조가 없고, CALCULATE_FRICTION_SPONGE·CALCULATE_DIFFUSION_SPONGE·CALCULATE_SPONGE의 DXg/DYg/xx 중 DXg/DYg는 대입 뒤 미사용이며 xx는 미대입·미사용이다(L240,L247-L248; L379,L386-L387; L523,L529-L530).

base_member_text: Larsen-Dancy exponents use integer arithmetic 50*(...)/(Iwidth-1) (L204, L545, L565, L596, L617) — quantized steps and no Iwidth=1 guard; friction/diffusion ramps divide ri by 10.0 cells regardless of sponge width (L265 etc.)
audit_member_text: CALCULATE_SPONGE_MAKER와 CALCULATE_SPONGE의 지수식은 L194/L535 등에서 Iwidth=INT(width/spacing)+Nghost를 만든 뒤 L204, L545, L565, L596, L617에서 Iwidth-1로 나눈다. 양의 폭이어도 INT(width/spacing)=0이고 Nghost=1이면 Iwidth=1이 가능하며 0 나눗셈 검사가 없다.

base_member_text: ABSORBING_GENERATING_BC relaxes only Eta @L151 — the U/V relaxation lines are commented out (L153-L154) while HU/HV are rebuilt from the un-relaxed U,V @L156-L157; also the relaxation runs over the entire local grid (L132-L133) using SPONGE_TIDE_WEST from TIDE_MODULE (west array only, no east/south/north counterpart here)
audit_member_text: ABSORBING_GENERATING_BC는 Uin2D/Vin2D를 L107-L108에서 0으로 초기화하고 L137-L140에서 계산하지만, 이를 U/V에 적용하는 유일한 문장은 L153-L154에서 주석 처리되어 있다. 이어 L156-L157은 기존 U/V로 HU/HV를 재계산하므로 계산된 속도 경계 성분이 폐기된다.

base_member_text: BB/CC drop Phase_Ser (commented @L124-L125 vs active @L126-L127) — random/imported phases are not applied in this optimized path; whether Phase_LEFT/Phase_Ser entered Cm/Sm upstream is outside this file
SPONGE_DAMPING divides U,V by SPONGE even where MASK==0 (only ETA is mask-guarded, L69-L73)

CALCULATE_FRICTION_SPONGE declares SPONGE INTENT(OUT) @L237 and zeroes it @L250, but CALCULATE_DIFFUSION_SPONGE/CALCULATE_SPONGE use INTENT(INOUT) (L376, L520) preserving prior content via lim — the three routines write the same-named argument with different accumulation conventions (note @L244-L245)

CALCULATE_SPONGE reset floor A_Sponge**(R_Sponge**50) (L579, L631): R_Sponge**50 is a REAL exponentiation here while the ramp exponents are integer-quantized — the cutoff value's consistency with the ramp is implicit

tmp_glob is allocated on all ranks @L671 (only rank 0 fills it) and deallocated @L785; receiving ranks' CD_breakwater is filled by mpi_irecv @L775 relying on Mloc==Niend-Nista+1+2*Nghost shape match — unchecked in this file
